title: Ethiopian-Style Vegan Stew
description: A flavorful and spicy vegan stew inspired by Ethiopian cuisine, made with galangal and atakilt.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add galangal and cook, stirring occasionally, until fragrant, about 5 minutes.
Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add atakilt, tomato, and berbere spice mix. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes.
Add xtra and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, until the vegetables are tender, about 20 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro, if desired.
